name: OpenMind Navigation
tagline: ROS 2 navigation stack for autonomous robots
whatItDoes: Provides modular navigation and path planning for autonomous robots with global/local path planning, obstacle avoidance, and goal execution. Integrates with ROS 2 and supports various locomotion configurations.
whyItSavesTime: Drop-in navigation solution eliminates weeks of ROS 2 navigation tuning and configuration. Optimized for NVIDIA edge platforms with pre-configured path planners.
health_check_command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && ros2 node list | grep -q "nav2" || exit 1'
